answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to one ferrous ore sample assayed from a named canyon mine shaft, certified in person by a licensed assayer who stamps its serial into a public register. Random spot-checks summon the holder into their own shaft at zenith to read the assay tag live on camera. One operator cannot be inside two shafts at once, and the assay fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real shaft, another assayer visit, another live human at noon, and twice the prior fee.
